### Blocking finding

**The legacy pre-staging guard checks only the destination of a rename.** R82 correctly rejects the R27 fixture’s staged modification to `outside.txt` before the legacy index commit. It also preserves the R81 positive control where a successful security command produces an ordinary in-project result. But `pendingPaths` keeps the destination and skips the source in Git’s NUL-delimited rename record. If a security or audit command stages a rename from outside the allowed scope into the project, the guard sees only the allowed destination. The subsequent `git add -A` and index commit can include the outside-project deletion. This is a static finding verified against the source and Git’s documented record format. The retained R27 test covers a modification at a single path.
